subject: EU-only processing: SCCs + implementation timeline and audit log logistics
messages:
From: Alice Durant <alice@medisys.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medisys.com, security@medisys.com
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: EU-only processing + SCCs — next steps and schedule

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Medisys is preparing an implementation window and needs a firm plan from Redwood on the following so we can brief legal and procurement:

- Confirmation that all inference and logs for our tenant will be processed and stored only in the EU region (we're targeting Frankfurt).
- The timeline for SCCs execution + any required customer actions (e.g., signing).
- Evidence we can provide to our auditors that deletion requests (and backups) are handled within X days, and the format of any proof of deletion.
- A sample of the audit logs we can expect (token-level redaction options, retention windows).

Can you send a single doc that maps steps to owners and dates? Procurement needs a week to route PO if onboarding dependencies are clear. We also requested a sample audit-log extract.

Appreciate it,
Alice

--
Alice Durant
Head of Platform Security, Medisys Health
alice@medisys.com
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Alice Durant <alice@medisys.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 10:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: EU-only processing + SCCs — next steps and schedule

Hi Alice — thanks, summarized below and attaching a draft implementation timeline and a redacted audit-log sample.

Short answers up front:
- EU-only inference + logs: yes. We will provision a tenant in the Frankfurt region and restrict routing to eu-central-1 for all processing and storage.
- SCCs: Redwood will provide the standard EU SCCs addendum. Signing workflow: we (Redwood) init a DocuSign envelope; Medisys signs; legal countersign if required. Expected turnaround: 3–7 business days once both parties are routed.
- Deletion and proof: standard deletion within primary systems is 48 hours; backups are purged within 30 days (can accelerate to 14 days under contractual agreement). Proof of deletion: we provide a signed attestation and a deletion log extract listing object ids, timestamps, and retained/erased flags.
- Audit logs: attached sample (redacted). We support token-level hashing, event types, and per-request region tag. Retention policy is configurable per account; default 90 days.

Action items / owners (high level):
- Redwood: create dedicated EU tenant (Dylan) — target: 2028-04-06
- Redwood Legal: send SCCs envelope (Lauren) — target: 2028-04-04
- Medisys: review & sign SCCs (Alice / Procurement) — target: 2028-04-11
- Ops: enable audit-log retention and deletion windows (Naomi / Karthik) — target: coordinate during onboarding week

Attachments: redwood_sccs_implementation_timeline.xlsx (timeline + owners), audit_log_sample.txt (redacted).

Let me know if you want us to accelerate any step — we can push SCCs routing earlier if procurement needs.

Best,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Customer Reliability Manager | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 13:02:00 +0100
Subject: Fwd: EU-only processing + SCCs — next steps and schedule

Team —

Looping you in on Medisys' ask. A few notes from legal's side before we send the envelope:

1) On deletion proofs: legal prefers an independently verifiable deletion log format (CSV with object id, region tag, deletion timestamp, deletion-actor id). They also want an attestation with an ISO-style audit trail.
2) On backups: Medisys asked for a 14-day backup purge as an option. We can offer 30-day standard and 14-day as a paid compliance add-on. Pricing to request from sales if they pick 14-day.
3) On SCCs: include a short cover letter clarifying that operator access is restricted to named roles and that access must be approved by customer security.

Naomi / Karthik, please confirm the operational feasibility of generating the CSV deletion extract and what is needed to sign off on a 14-day backup purge (risk, runbook changes, verification steps).

Thanks,
Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 08:17:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Fwd: EU-only processing + SCCs — next steps and schedule

Lauren / team —

Operational notes (summary):

- Deletion extract: ops can produce CSV with fields: object_id, account_id, region, deletion_type, deletion_timestamp, source_request_id, operator_id. We will hash sensitive identifiers; include an HMAC signature per file for tamper-evidence. Sample attached: audit_log_sample.txt.
- Backups: default pipeline currently retains snapshots for 30 days across our snapshot store (region-scoped). To implement a 14-day purge policy we need: a signed change control, a short maintenance window (10–30 minutes during low traffic) to run accelerated garbage collection, and an expanded verification runbook to produce the attestation.
- Effort estimate: 1.5 engineer-days to add the export pipeline + HMAC signing; 0.5 days for runbook updates; 0.5 days for verification/test. We can schedule during onboarding week.

Risks: accelerated purge increases chance of irrecoverable data loss if customer requests rollback within the 14-day window. Recommend adding a short SLA clause that covers emergency retention extension with an agreed fee and 24–48 hour lead time.

I'll prepare a short ops note for the SCCs cover letter.

Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Durant <alice@medisys.com>

Dylan / Lauren —

This looks good and addresses the majority of legal's questions. A couple of clarifications before procurement issues the PO:

- Please include the HMAC-signed CSV deletion extract as part of the deliverable at go-live. We will retain the proof in our audit portal.
- We prefer the 14-day backup purge option; Medisys is willing to accept the compliance add-on charge. Please send the cost delta and contract language.
- For SCCs signing: can you confirm whether the DocuSign envelope will include the cover letter referencing operator role restrictions? If so, procurement can proceed once they see the envelope.

If you can send a revised timeline with the 14-day option and the cost delta, I will route to procurement today.

Thanks — talk soon.

Alice
